urgentPolicies.title: Digital Markets Act: Section 4 Amendment
urgentPolicies.description: A demo policy update focused on platform interoperability and fair access for smaller digital service providers.
urgentPolicies.eligibility: Applies to digital platforms and online intermediaries operating within the sample regulatory framework.
urgentPolicies.benefits: Aims to improve competition and transparency for small vendors and customers through access and reporting requirements.

urgentPolicies.title: National AI Safety Framework 2.0
urgentPolicies.description: A demo framework for safety expectations in AI systems used by regulated industries.
urgentPolicies.eligibility: Relevant for organizations deploying AI systems in finance, healthcare, or public services under the sample regime.
urgentPolicies.benefits: Supports safer AI adoption through transparency, oversight, and risk management guidance.

recommendedPolicies.title: Sustainable Finance Disclosure Measures
recommendedPolicies.description: A demo policy that outlines disclosure expectations for sustainability reporting in finance.
recommendedPolicies.eligibility: Applies to financial institutions with sustainability-linked products.
recommendedPolicies.benefits: Improves investor confidence and supports green capital allocation.

recommendedPolicies.title: Net-Zero Infrastructure Act
recommendedPolicies.description: A demo policy focused on infrastructure investment and incentives to reduce emissions.
recommendedPolicies.eligibility: Targets infrastructure projects with net-zero commitments.
recommendedPolicies.benefits: Encourages cleaner energy investments and long-term emissions reduction.

recommendedPolicies.title: Digital Trade Facilitation Act
recommendedPolicies.description: A demo policy streamlining cross-border digital commerce and regulatory compliance.
recommendedPolicies.eligibility: Applies to businesses engaged in international digital goods and services.
recommendedPolicies.benefits: Simplifies compliance and reduces friction for cross-border e-commerce.
